acts.title: Act I • The Crow, The Vessel, and The Light
acts.tagline: A wordless fable of perseverance, illumination, and friendship
acts.origin: Aesop Perry Index 198 & Panchatantra with Wayang Kulit performance traditions

beats.name: The Kindling
beats.narrative: An open palm wakes the brass lantern. Warm amber light floods the parchment wall, casting the initial sacred circle.
beats.culturalNote: Inspired by the Dalang lighting the Blencong coconut-oil lamp in Wayang Kulit.

beats.name: The Origami Beak
beats.narrative: A pointed shadow beak opens on the parchment. Hold steady for two seconds as paper perforations shiver into life.
beats.culturalNote: Rooted in Karasu-dawn motifs and public-domain folklore.

beats.name: Flight Beyond the Wall
beats.gesture: Index and middle spread; vertical flap
beats.narrative: The crow breaks away from the hand silhouette, bends around the real physical room corner, and soars into the sky.
beats.culturalNote: Hero mixed-reality moment: virtual shadow geometry conforming to real room mesh.

beats.name: The Thirst & The Rising Water
beats.narrative: Dropping glowing river pebbles into the dry pitcher. Each stone rings with a resonant ceramic ping, raising the tide.
beats.culturalNote: Classic Aesopian lesson: persistence and tool usage over brute force.

beats.name: The Duet Across the Wall
beats.gesture: Two hands meet or summon guest shadow
beats.narrative: A stranger's shadow hand reaches across your real wall. Palms meet in passthrough, igniting the shelf of lanterns.
beats.culturalNote: Shared presence in mixed reality without controllers or voice chat.

traditions.name: Wayang Kulit
traditions.description: Master Dalang puppeteers animate intricate leather puppets behind a cotton screen (Kelir) illuminated by an overhead oil flame.

traditions.name: Chhaya Natak
traditions.description: Sanskrit shadow drama dating back to the Natya Shastra, exploring philosophical epics through illuminated silhouettes.

traditions.name: Aesopica
traditions.description: Oral animal parables passed down and recorded across millennia, emphasizing wisdom, humility, and ingenuity.
